```{r Enriched Heatmap}
# ---- Libraries ----
library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(EnrichedHeatmap)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

# ---- Settings ----
feature_mode <- "cds"  # or "exon" or "intron"

feature_label <- if (feature_mode == "cds") {
  "Canonical CDS"
} else {
  "Canonical Exons"
}

# ---- Setup lists ----
Species_Features_gtf <- list()
Species_Canonical_Mappings <- list()
MutationDensityPlots <- list()
MutationDensityData <- list()

# ---- Helper ----
get_feature_ranges <- function(full.gtf, canonical_map, feature_mode = c("cds", "exon")) {
  feature_mode <- match.arg(feature_mode)
  canonical_ids <- canonical_map$transcriptId

  if (feature_mode == "cds") {
    feat <- full.gtf[full.gtf$type == "CDS" &
                     full.gtf$transcript_id %in% canonical_ids]
  } else {
    feat <- full.gtf[full.gtf$type == "exon" &
                     full.gtf$transcript_id %in% canonical_ids]
  }

  # ✅ IMPORTANT FIX: use GenomicRanges::reduce
  GenomicRanges::reduce(feat, ignore.strand = TRUE)
}

# ---- Main loop ----
lapply(names(Reduced_Variants), function(element_name) {

  element <- Reduced_Variants[[element_name]]

  build <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 5]
  species <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 4] %>%
    str_replace("^(.)(.*)$", "\\1_\\2")

  full.gtf <- rtracklayer::import(
    paste0("/home/ocdm0351/.conda/envs/snpEff/share/snpeff-5.2-2/data/",
           species, "/", build, "/genes.gtf")
  )

  Species_Canonical_Mappings[[element_name]] <<- read_tsv(
    paste0("/home/ocdm0351/DPhil/R_Data/Canonical_Transcripts_",
           species, "_", build, "_snpEffSift.tsv")
  )

  feature_ranges <- get_feature_ranges(
    full.gtf,
    Species_Canonical_Mappings[[element_name]],
    feature_mode
  )

  Species_Features_gtf[[element_name]] <<- feature_ranges

  # ---- Variants ----
  variant_ranges <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    element,
    keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
    ignore.strand = TRUE,
    seqnames.field = "CHROM",
    start.field = "POS",
    end.field = "POS"
  )

  variant_ranges <- coverage(variant_ranges)
  variant_ranges <- as(variant_ranges, "GRanges")
  variant_ranges <- variant_ranges[variant_ranges$score > 0]

  # ---- Parameters ----
  mean_mode_type <- "absolute"
  extend_value <- 1000
  window <- 50
  target_ratio_value <- 0.6

  # ---- Normalize ----
  body_variants <- normalizeToMatrix(
    variant_ranges,
    feature_ranges,
    extend = extend_value,
    mean_mode = mean_mode_type,
    w = window,
    target_ratio = target_ratio_value,
    smooth = TRUE,
    background = 0
  )

  # ---- Summarise ----
  avg <- colMeans(body_variants)
  se <- apply(body_variants, 2, function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)))

  MutationDensities <- data.frame(
    position = seq_along(avg),
    mean_score = avg,
    se = se,
    species = species,
    element_name = element_name
  )

  MutationDensityData[[element_name]] <<- MutationDensities

  # ---- Individual plot ----
  regionLength <- round(target_ratio_value * length(avg))
  lengthEachSide <- (length(avg) - regionLength) / 2
  start <- lengthEachSide
  end <- length(avg) - lengthEachSide

  MutationDensityPlot <-
    ggplot(MutationDensities, aes(x = position, y = mean_score)) +
    geom_line(color = "#66ff00", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = mean_score - se, ymax = mean_score + se),
      fill = "orange", alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = start, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = end, linetype = "dotted") +
    labs(
      x = "Windows",
      y = "Mutation Density",
      title = paste(element_name, "\nMutational Frequency Around", feature_label)
    )

  MutationDensityPlots[[element_name]] <<- MutationDensityPlot
})

# ---- REMOVE human datasets ----
MutationDensityData <- MutationDensityData[
  !grepl("Hsapiens", names(MutationDensityData))
]

# ---- Combine ----
Combined_MutationDensityData <- bind_rows(MutationDensityData)

# ---- Normalize within species ----
Combined_MutationDensityData <- Combined_MutationDensityData %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(mean_score = mean_score / mean(mean_score)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- Define boundaries ----
target_ratio_value <- 0.6
extend_value <- 1000

n_bins <- max(Combined_MutationDensityData$position)

regionLength <- target_ratio_value * n_bins
lengthEachSide <- (n_bins - regionLength) / 2

start_bin <- lengthEachSide
end_bin <- n_bins - lengthEachSide

# ---- Combined plot ----
MultiSpeciesPlot <-
  ggplot(Combined_MutationDensityData,
         aes(x = position,
             y = mean_score,
             color = species,
             fill = species)) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +

  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_score - se, ymax = mean_score + se),
    alpha = 0.2,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  annotate("rect",
           xmin = start_bin, xmax = end_bin,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.05, fill = "grey") +

  geom_vline(xintercept = start_bin, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = end_bin, linetype = "dashed") +

  annotate("text", x = start_bin,
           y = max(Combined_MutationDensityData$mean_score),
           label = "Start", vjust = -0.5) +

  annotate("text", x = end_bin,
           y = max(Combined_MutationDensityData$mean_score),
           label = "End", vjust = -0.5) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, start_bin, end_bin, n_bins),
    labels = c(paste0("-", extend_value),
               "Start",
               "End",
               paste0("+", extend_value))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = paste0("Position relative to ", feature_label),
    y = "Relative Mutation Enrichment",
    title = paste("Mutation Enrichment Around", feature_label, "(Non-human species)")
  ) +

  theme_minimal()

# ---- Save ----
ggsave(
  filename = paste0("/home/ocdm0351/DPhil/R_Data/Plots/2_GeneBody_Plots/",
                    feature_mode, "/MultiSpecies_", feature_mode, "_Enrichment.png"),
  plot = MultiSpeciesPlot,
  width = 25,
  height = 15,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 1000,
  bg = "transparent"
)
```
